selection_protocol.method: SHA-256 seeded Monday selection fixed before any v31 performance run; exact dates were absent from prior candidate files
selection_protocol.opening_rule: week 2 opens only when week 1 is full_pass or promising_but_not_complete; week 3 opens only when week 2 also advances
selection_protocol.ablation_rule: if week 1 primary stops, run the immediate-reversal control on the identical week and change no other variable
selection_protocol.long_evaluation_rule: no long evaluation until all three frozen primary weeks advance

frozen_market_logic.representation: daily causal cost-resolved equal-notional event bars calibrated only from the preceding completed UTC day
frozen_market_logic.initiative: three-event coherent aggressive-flow shock, at least 40bp move, efficient path and close beyond completed 20-event external structure
frozen_market_logic.pullback: first completed event with opposite aggressive flow and adverse price change while its close still preserves outside value
frozen_market_logic.primary_direction_resolution: do not assume continuation; reverse only when a later official venue TradeTick crosses back through the accepted boundary
frozen_market_logic.primary_entry: NautilusTrader STOP_LIMIT one 0.1 BTC tick through the accepted boundary with a 7bp worst-fill cap
frozen_market_logic.invalidation: completed pullback outside extreme plus one 7bp side-cost buffer
frozen_market_logic.target: opposite edge of the completed pre-initiative 20-event structure
frozen_market_logic.single_ablation: immediate-reversal-control enters the identical reversal on the first official venue TradeTick after the completed pullback; detector, direction, invalidation, target, risk, cost and hold are unchanged
frozen_market_logic.pending_cancel: cancel when the reversal target or pullback invalidation trades before entry, or when the causal remaining response window expires
frozen_market_logic.execution_data: official Binance Vision USD-M BTCUSDT aggregate trades converted one-for-one to NautilusTrader TradeTick

economic_rationale.v30_failure: outside value surviving one counterflow event did not establish continuation; both first- and second-expansion targets lost on the same week
economic_rationale.v31_hypothesis: a later loss of the accepted boundary distinguishes a failed auction from a merely corrective pullback; the opposite structure edge is the causal liquidity destination
economic_rationale.microstructure_basis: aggressive-flow impact is state dependent and book resilience or replenishment can turn an apparent initiative into transient impact; therefore direction is resolved by subsequent boundary behavior rather than by imbalance sign alone
